scientific_integrity: Theorem on a specified infinite family, proved by a marked finite-state reduction, exhaustive finite certificate, and local symmetry arguments. Verification programs are included without claims of independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary zero forcing and unrestricted one-vertex exchange for n>=6. The known minimum forcing number is not claimed new. Some older prism-specific full text was inaccessible; historical equivalence under alternate names remains possible.
title: Thirteen linear families of minimum zero-forcing sets in cycle prisms
